messages:
Maya (Product): Quick check on the Private setup wizard connection step. On mobile the host list wraps and hides actions. Screenshot: https://redwood.design/s/conn-mobile
Oliver (Design): Propose compact rows: icon + truncated name + status pill + chevron. Keeps primary CTA visible.
Sam (Engineering): CSS suggestion: .row { display:flex; gap:8px; align-items:center } .label { min-width:0; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis } Small JS: debounce UI state updates 250ms to avoid flicker.
Jordan (Accessibility): Rows must be real buttons with aria-expanded and aria-controls. Add a role=status aria-live=polite summary that says "X of Y probes passed" (debounced). Do not steal focus on small updates.
Priya (PM): Microcopy tweaks: replace 'Port 22 fail' with 'SSH (port 22) blocked  Check host firewall or security group.' CTAs verb-first: 'Continue setup' (primary), 'Retry checks' (secondary), 'View logs' (tertiary).
Oliver (Design): Dark mode chips: add 1px outline and bolder text weight to meet contrast. Will post token variants in Figma.
Maya (Product): Acceptance criteria I'll add to the ticket: 1) compact host rows <=480px, 2) collapsed logs by default with accessible expand, 3) aria-live summary debounced 250ms, 4) keyboard-toggle rows with aria-expanded, 5) chip colors meet 4.5:1 in both themes. @Oliver post Figma, @Sam add e2e.
